method: Sum the observed July 6.1 billion and August 4.7 billion contracts, then model the unobserved September volume as a positive lognormal with mean 4.7 x 30/31 = 4.548387 billion (unchanged August daily rate) and subjective coefficient of variation 35%, giving mean Q3 volume 15.348387 billion. The CV is not fitted, allows September activity to differ materially, and the script integrates independent uniform +/-0.05 billion errors for each preliminary observed month to represent assumed rounding and small revisions. Assume the reported quarterly volume rounds to the nearest 0.1 billion, so a strictly-above outcome uses a latent total at least strike + 0.05 billion; broader revisions are only a model limitation, and checked refreshed indexes, attempted September releases and searches supplied no newer numerical measurement.
